y-m-73-07.title: "Inflation Inodzikira Kwegore Rechipiri Rakatevedzana" Inoreva Here Kuti Mitengo Yakadzikira?
y-m-73-07.goal: Siyanisa mwero wemitengo nekukurumidza kwekukwira kwemitengo, uye, uchishandisa nhamba dziri mutafura, gadzirisa musoro wenhau nenzira inonzwisisika kumudzidzi we middle-school.
y-m-73-07.material:
Musoro wenhau yechinyorwa uti "Inflation Inodzikira Kwegore Rechipiri Rakatevedzana". Consumer price index (ne2021 se100; data yekufungidzira) ndeiyi. Verenga tafura nenhevedzano gore, price index, kukwira pamusoro pegore rapfuura. Kukwira kunoitwa round kune decimal place imwe.

Gore | Price index (2021=100) | Kukwira pamusoro pegore rapfuura
2021 | 100.0 | -
2022 | 105.0 | 5.0%
2023 | 108.5 | 3.3%
2024 | 110.6 | 1.9%

(Kukwira pamusoro pegore rapfuura = index yegore iroro iri hombe zvakadii % kupfuura index yegore rapfuura. Fungidzira kuti mutengo wekutenga chinhu chimwe chete unoenderana neprice index.)
y-m-73-07.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza zvose zvinogona kutaurwa nechokwadi netafura oga.
y-m-73-07.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga column yeprice index chete kubva kumusoro kuenda kuzasi, uye utarise kana nhamba dzakakura kana diki.
y-m-73-07.s.s1.hint.1: Verenga column yerate yekuwedzera zvakaparadzana, uye uzive kana chirevo chimwe nechimwe chiri chenezve index kana nezverate yekuwedzera.
y-m-73-07.s.s1.o.a: Mwero wemitengo muna 2024 wakava pasi kupfuura muna 2022.
y-m-73-07.s.s1.r.a: Price index yakakwira kubva ku 105.0 kusvika ku 110.6. Wakaverenga rate yekukwira ichideredza sekureva chinhu chimwechete nekudzika kwemitengo.
y-m-73-07.s.s1.o.b: Mwero wemitengo muna 2024 i wakakwira kupfuura muna 2023.
y-m-73-07.s.s1.r.b: Wakaverenga chokwadi chekuti index yakakwira kubva ku 108.5 kusvika ku 110.6. Wakanzwisisa kuti kana rate yekukwira i positive (+), mwero unokwira.
y-m-73-07.s.s1.o.c: Rate yekukwira yakaramba ichideredza, saka mitengo ichadzika muna 2025.
y-m-73-07.s.s1.r.c: Wakatora mutemo wemakore matatu apfuura semhedzisiro yakasimbiswa yegore rinotevera. Tebhura haina ruzivo nezve 2025.
y-m-73-07.s.s1.o.d: Huwandu (mu percent) hwemitengo yakakwira gore rimwe nerimwe hwakadzika zvishoma nezvishoma.
y-m-73-07.s.s1.r.d: Wakaverenga kuchinja kwema rates ekukwira 5.0%, 3.3%, 1.9%. Ichi i chirevo nezvehukuru hwekukwira, kwete nezve mwero.
y-m-73-07.s.s1.explain: Kubva muna 2022 kusvika muna 2024 price index yakaramba ichikwira: 105.0 → 108.5 → 110.6 (b). Rate yekukwira yakadzika: 5.0%, 3.3%, 1.9% (d). Asi rate yekukwira idiki hairevi kuti mwero wemitengo wakadzika (a i yenhema). Tebhura haigone kutaura zvichaitika muna 2025 (c).
y-m-73-07.s.s2.prompt: Shamwari yakaona nyaya ndokuti, 'Mitengo inoramba ichidzika, saka zvekudya zvichachipa ikozvino.' Mumashoko 2 kusvika 3, nyora tsananguro inogadzirisa zvinoreva musoro wenyaya, uchishandisa nhamba imwe kana mbiri kubva mutebhura, kuti kunyange munin'ina we middle school anzwisise.
y-m-73-07.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wanyora mushoko rimwe rinoenzanisa ma price indexes e 2022 ne 2024.
y-m-73-07.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora zvakare 'rate yekukwira yakadzika' nekuenzanisa kwezuva nezuva, sa 'kumhanya kwakanonoka'.
y-m-73-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakatarisa kuti nhamba dzawakatora mutebhura dzakarurama here?
y-m-73-07.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakanyora nemashoko anogona kuverengwa nemudzidzi we middle school (wakawedzera tsananguro kumashoko akaoma) here?
y-m-73-07.s.s2.model.0: Mitengo haina kudzika; yakaramba ichikwira. Kubva ku 105.0 muna 2022 kusvika ku 110.6 muna 2024, saka zvinhu zvakadhura. Zvinongova kuti huwandu hwekukwira gore rimwe nerimwe hwakadzika: 5.0%, 3.3%, 1.9%.
y-m-73-07.s.s2.model.1: Nyaya inoreva kuti kumhanya kwekukwira kwemitengo kwanonoka. 2023 i 108.5 uye 2024 i 110.6, saka mutengo pachawo wakakwirabe. Haina kuchipa.
y-m-73-07.s.s2.model.2: Sezvinoita motokari ichienderera mberi kunyange kana kumhanya kwayo kwanonoka, mitengo yakangokwira zvinyoronyoro, uye index ichiri yakakwira kubva ku 100 kusvika ku 110.6. Saka mitengo haina kuchipa; iri kukwira zvinyoronyoro.

y-m-73-05.title: Sarudzo dzevanhu dzinogona kusiyana kunyange kana expected values dzakafanana here?
y-m-73-05.goal: Tsanangura kuti kunyange kana expected values dzakafanana, sarudzo dzinogona kusiyana zvichienderana nekuti vanhu vanonzwa sei nezvenjodzi yekurasikirwa kukuru, uye ugadzire iwe pachako mamiriro apo kutenga insurance kuri kuwana kudiki zvikuru mu expected value.
y-m-73-05.material: Kana ukashandisa foni kwegore, screen yayo inogona kutyoka. Semuenzaniso wekufungidzira, probability yekutyoka mugore rimwe ndi6% (fungidzira kuti inogona kutyoka kamwe pagore pamusoro), uye kana ikatyoka, mutengo wekugadzirisa ndi40만 원. Damage insurance inofukidza mutengo wose wekugadzirisa kana ukabhadhara premium yegore ye2만 4천 원 (deductible ye0 won). Fungidzira kuti probability inozikanwa chaizvo.
y-m-73-05.thinking.2: Kutonga nechiyero chakasiyana ne expected value
y-m-73-05.prereq.0: Probability ne expected value (sum ye probability × kukosha)
y-m-73-05.s.s1.prompt: Kana ukaenzanisa kutenga insurance nekusatenga ne 'expected value yemari inoshandiswa pagore', kuongorora kwakakodzera zvakanyanya ndekupi?
y-m-73-05.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora huwandu hwose hwekushandisa hunogoneka pagore pasina insurance, uye unyore probability yeimwe neimwe padivi payo.
y-m-73-05.s.s1.hint.1: Tsvaga avhareji yenyaya idzodzo uye uienzanise ne premium, uye ufunge kuti kushandisa kupi kunoonekwa chaizvo kana ukatarisa gore rimwe chete.
y-m-73-05.s.s1.o.a: Expected values dzakafanana, saka chero chaunosarudza, mari yaunoshandisa pagore yakafanana zvakadaro.
y-m-73-05.s.s1.r.a: Expected value ndiyo avhareji pamusoro penguva dzakawanda. Wakasiya kuti kushandisa chaiko pagore rimwe nerimwe kunogona kuparadzana kuita 0 won kana 40만 원.
y-m-73-05.s.s1.o.b: 6% probability diki, saka kukuvara hakuzoitiki, uye kutenga insurance kurasikirwa chete.
y-m-73-05.s.s1.r.b: Wakashandura probability diki kuita 'haizoitiki'. Poinzi yenyaya ndeyekuti kunyange pa6%, kana ikaitika inodhura zvakawanda.
y-m-73-05.s.s1.o.c: Premium diki zvikuru kupfuura mutengo wekugadzirisa, saka kutenga insurance kuwana chete.
y-m-73-05.s.s1.r.c: Wakaenzanisa saizi dzepremium nemutengo wekugadzirisa chete. Unofanira kuwedzera neprobability yekuti kugadzirisa kunodiwa kuti uite kuenzanisa kweavhareji.
y-m-73-05.s.s1.o.d: Expected values dzakafanana saka hapana iri nani, uye chinoparadzanisa sarudzo ndechekuti unoda kudzivisa njodzi yemutengo mukuru here.
y-m-73-05.s.s1.r.d: Wakawana chiyero chinosara kana expected values dzakafanana (njodzi yaunogona kutakura yakadii).
y-m-73-05.s.s1.explain: Pasina insurance, mutengo unotarisirwa wekugadzirisa ndi0.06 × 40만 = 2만 4천 원, yakafanana nepremium. Paavhareji hapana iri nani, asi pasina insurance pane mukana we6% wekuti 40만 원 ibude yose kamwe. Kuti munhu anoda kudzivisa njodzi iyi zvakadii kunoenderana nemunhu nemamiriro.
y-m-73-05.s.s2.prompt: Rega probability yekukuvara ive p% uye mutengo wekugadzirisa ive r 만 원. Premium inoramba iri 2만 4천 원, uye isa mapeya 3 akasiyana (p, r) apo mutengo unotarisirwa wekugadzirisa pasina insurance (= r × p/100, mu 만 원) uri mukuru kupfuura premium asi 3만 원 kana pasi (kuwana kudiki zvikuru). p ndi integer kubva ku1 kusvika ku50, uye r ndi integer kubva ku10 kusvika ku100.
y-m-73-05.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza probability imwe p nemutengo wekugadzirisa r, uverenge p × r, uye uienzanise ne240 ne300.
y-m-73-05.s.s2.hint.1: Kana wawana peya imwe inogutsa mamiriro, chinja p uye ugadzirise r kuti utsvage imwe peya.
y-m-73-05.s.s2.ok.c1: p ne r ndema integers mukati merenji.
y-m-73-05.s.s2.fail.c1: p inofanira kuva integer kubva ku1 kusvika ku50, uye r inofanira kuva integer kubva ku10 kusvika ku100.
y-m-73-05.s.s2.ok.c2: Mutengo unotarisirwa wekugadzirisa wakakura kupfuura premium ye2.4만 원.
y-m-73-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Mutengo unotarisirwa wekugadzirisa (r × p/100) unofanira kuva mukuru kupfuura 2.4만 원. Tarisa kana p × r yakakura kupfuura 240.
y-m-73-05.s.s2.ok.c3: Mutengo unotarisirwa wekugadzirisa ndi3만 원 kana pasi.
y-m-73-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Mutengo unotarisirwa wekugadzirisa uri pamusoro pe3만 원. Dzikisa imwe yazvo kuti p × r ive 300 kana pasi.
y-m-73-05.s.s2.explain: Mutengo unotarisirwa wekugadzirisa r × p/100 unofanira kuva wakakura kupfuura 2.4 uye 3 kana pasi, saka p × r inofanira kuva yakakura kupfuura 240 uye 300 kana pasi. Mienzaniso: (7, 40) inopa 2.8만 원, (10, 30) inopa 3만 원, (6, 50) inopa 3만 원, uye (5, 60) inopawo 3만 원. (6, 40) inopa 2.4만 원, yakafanana nepremium, saka haisi 'yakakura'.
y-m-73-05.s.s3.prompt: Mumamiriro e s1 (expected values dzakafanana), sarudza 'tenga insurance' kana 'usatenge insurance', fungidzira mamiriro emunhu uyo kuita izvozvo kunonzwisisika, uye unyore chikonzero pamwe nenhamba.
y-m-73-05.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora kushandisa mugore apo ichitsika pasina insurance nemugore apo isingatsiki.
y-m-73-05.s.s3.hint.1: Fungidzira kuti waizonzwa sei dai 40만 원 iyoyo yaitora chikamu chikuru cheakaundi yako yebhanga.
y-m-73-05.s.s3.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Kana mudzidzi ane mari yekushandisa yemwedzi ye ... saka ...
y-m-73-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakagamuchira here kuti expected values dzakafanana uye wakataura chiyero chakasiyana nacho?
y-m-73-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakafunga here kuti munhu anosarudza zvakapesana anogonawo kunzwisisika?
y-m-73-05.s.s3.model.0: Kumudzidzi ane mari yekushandisa ye10만 원 pamwedzi, zvakaoma kutakura mutengo wokukurumidza we40만 원. Kunyange avhareji yakafanana, 2만 4천 원 inobvisa njodzi yemutengo mukuru, saka kutenga insurance kunonzwisisika.
y-m-73-05.s.s3.model.1: Munhu ane 200만 원 mune zvaachengeta anogona kupfuura kunyange 40만 원 ikabuda. Kana probability iri 6%, avhareji yemutengo yakafanana nepremium, saka hapana chikonzero chekuibhadhara, uye munguva refu mari inoshandiswa inova yakafanana, saka zvakanaka kusatenga insurance.

y-m-73-03.title: Nhau inoti avhareji ndi500만 원
y-m-73-03.goal: Ziva kuti mean oga haigoni kushandiswa kutonga chirevo che 'vasingasviki hafu vanowana zvakawanda kupfuura huwandu hwakati', taura kuti ruzivo rupi rwekuwedzera rwunodiwa, uye ugadzire iwe pachako data ine mean imwe chete asi mhedziso dzakasiyana.
y-m-73-03.material: Pane mhuri 5 mumusha. Nhau imwe inoti 'Mean yemari inopindwa nemhuri yemwedzi mumusha uyu (before tax, unit: 만 원) ndi500', uye mutsara wekupedzisira wenhau imwe chete unoti 'Vasingasviki hafu yemhuri dzemumusha uyu vanowana zvakawanda kupfuura 400만 원 pamwedzi.' Mari inopinda yemhuri imwe neimwe haina kupiwa munhau. Mari yemwedzi yemhuri yega yega ndi100만 원 kana kupfuura, uye mari inopinda ndema integers (mu units dze 만 원).
y-m-73-03.thinking.1: Kugadzira muenzaniso unopikisa une mean imwe chete asi kugoverwa kwakasiyana
y-m-73-03.prereq.0: Nzira yekutsvaga mean ne median (kukosha kwepakati)
y-m-73-03.s.s1.prompt: Kunze kwe mean ye500, chii chaunoda kuziva kuti utonge nenzira iri nyore zvikuru kana mutsara wekupedzisira wenhau uri wechokwadi?
y-m-73-03.s.s1.hint.0: Fungidzira seti mbiri kana nhatu dzenhamba 5 dzine mean imwe chete asi zvimiro zvakasiyana.
y-m-73-03.s.s1.hint.1: Isa iwe pachako mari inopinda yemhuri 5, uye funga kuti kukosha kupi kwawaida mumuenzaniso uyu kuti uzive kana mutsara wekupedzisira wenhau uri wechokwadi kana nhema.
y-m-73-03.s.s1.o.a: Mari yemwedzi yemhuri iri pakati kana mari dzakarongwa nehukuru
y-m-73-03.s.s1.r.a: Kuti vasingasviki hafu vanopfuura kukosha kwakati kunobatanidzwa zvakananga nekukosha kwepakati kana kwakarongwa nehukuru. Wakawana representative value isiri mean.
y-m-73-03.s.s1.o.b: Mari yemwedzi yemhuri ine mari inopinda yepamusoro zvikuru
y-m-73-03.s.s1.r.b: Kukosha kukuru kunokuudza chii chinosimudza mean, asi hakukuudzi kuti mari inopinda dzemamwe mhuri dzakapararira sei.
y-m-73-03.s.s1.o.c: Mean ye500 yakaverengwa kusvika kune decimal places 2
y-m-73-03.s.s1.r.c: Kunyange kana ukanyora mean zvakanyatsonaka, haugoni kusiyanisa kugoverwa kwakasiyana kune mean imwe chete.
y-m-73-03.s.s1.o.d: Kukosha kubva pakutarisa zvakare kuti mhuri dzingani dzinogara mumusha uyu
y-m-73-03.s.s1.r.d: Huwandu hwemhuri hwatopiwa se5, uye kunyange nekukosha uku, kugoverwa hakuoneki mu mean.
y-m-73-03.s.s1.explain: Kana mhuri 5 dzakarongwa nehukuru, mhuri yechi3 iri pakati. 'Vasingasviki hafu vanowana zvakawanda kupfuura 400' zvinoreva zvakafanana nekuti mari inopinda yemhuri iri pakati yakakura kupfuura 400. Mean inogona kukweverwa zvakasimba nemhuri imwe kana mbiri dzine mari yakakwirira zvikuru, saka haikwani pakutonga uku. (Zvechokwadi, kuziva mari inopinda yemhuri yega yega kwaizokwanawo, asi kana ukasarudza chinhu chimwe chete, ndiko kukosha kwepakati.)
y-m-73-03.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira seti 2 dzakasiyana dzemhuri 5 dzine mean 500 chaizvo asi apo mutsara wekupedzisira wenhau ('vasingasviki hafu vanowana zvakawanda kupfuura 400') uri wenhema. Isa mari inopinda nenhevedzano kubva padiki se a ≤ b ≤ c ≤ d ≤ e. (Kukosha kumwe chete kunogona kuoneka kakawanda.)
y-m-73-03.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wanyora nhamba shanu kuti sum ive 2500, uye utarise kuti nhamba yepakati ndeipi kana dzakarongwa nehukuru.
y-m-73-03.s.s2.hint.1: Edza kuti sum yenhamba dzimwe ina inochinja sei kana ukaita nhamba hombe zvikuru e kuva hombe.
y-m-73-03.s.s2.var.a: Mhuri ine mari diki zvikuru inopinda (만 원)
y-m-73-03.s.s2.var.e: Mhuri ine mari huru zvikuru inopinda (만 원)
y-m-73-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Dzakarongwa kubva padiki, uye dzose ndema integers dzine 100 kana kupfuura.
y-m-73-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Dzinyore nenhevedzano kubva padiki (a ≤ b ≤ c ≤ d ≤ e), uye dzose dzinofanira kuva integers dziri 100 kana kupfuura.
y-m-73-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Sum yenhamba shanu inofanira kuva 2500 kuti mean ive 500.
y-m-73-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Kana mhuri iri pakati (c) iri pamusoro pe400, saka mhuri 3 kana kupfuura dziri pamusoro pe400. Tarisa kuti unofanira kuitei ne c kuti chirevo chenhau chive chenhema.
y-m-73-03.s.s2.explain: Muenzaniso: (100, 200, 300, 400, 1500) ine sum ye2500 nekukosha kwepakati kwe300, saka mhuri 1 chete inowana zvakawanda kupfuura 400. (400, 400, 400, 400, 900) ine mhuri 4 pa '400 kana pasi'. Sezvo ichiti 'zvakawanda kupfuura', mhuri pa400 haisi inowana zvakawanda. Kunyange nemean imwe chete, kana mhuri imwe yakakura zvikuru, dzimwe dzinogona kuva diki.
y-m-73-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Uchishandisa mienzaniso yawakagadzira, nyora kana ruzivo rwekuti mean ndi500 oga rwakakwana kutonga mutsara wekupedzisira wenhau, uye upe chikonzero chako.
y-m-73-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Kumuenzaniso wawakagadzira, nyora mean, mhuri iri pakati, nemhuri hombe zvikuru, mutsara mumwe imwe neimwe.
y-m-73-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Fungawo seti imwe yemhuri 5 dzine mean imwe chete apo mutsara wenhau uri wechokwadi, uye uenzanise mienzaniso miviri.
y-m-73-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora mutsananguro yako here kuti mumuenzaniso wawakagadzira, mean ndi500 asi chirevo chenhau chenhema?
y-m-73-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakataura here chinhu chiri chikonzero, senge 'mhuri iri pakati' kana 'kukosha kukuru zvikuru'?
y-m-73-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Wakafungawo here nezvechokwadi chekuti mutsara wenhau waigona kuva wechokwadi (kana kukosha kwepakati kuri kukuru kupfuura 400)?
y-m-73-03.s.s2.because.model.0: Kunyange kana mean iri 500, kana mhuri imwe iri yakakwirira zvikuru, senge 1500, dzimwe dzinogona kuva dzakaderera. Mumuenzaniso uri pamusoro, mean ndi500 asi mhuri iri pakati ndi300. Saka mean oga haigoni kuudza kana hafu vanowana zvakawanda kupfuura 400.
y-m-73-03.s.s2.because.model.1: Kana mari inopinda yemhuri dzimwe iri hombe zvikuru, mean inokweverwa kumusoro. Mean ndi500, asi mhuri 4 pakati pemhuri 5 dzinogona kuva pa400 kana pasi. Kutonga nemean oga hakukwani; unofanira kutarisawo kukosha kwepakati.
y-m-73-03.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Hazvitauri nyaya apo zviri zvechokwadi, asi zvinosangana nepoinzi huru

y-m-73-02.title: Nzvimbo ine mutengo wakaderera zvikuru pachinhu chimwe ndiyo ine mhindu huru zvikuru here?
y-m-73-02.topic: Mutengo weavhareji nehuwandu hwekugadzira une mhindu huru zvikuru
y-m-73-02.goal: Ongorora kuti huwandu hwekugadzira une mutengo weavhareji wakaderera zvikuru pachinhu chimwe nehuwandu une mhindu huru zvikuru zvinogona kusiyana, uchigadzirisa kutonga kwako sezvo ruzivo rwemitengo rwuchipiwa chidimbu nechidimbu.
y-m-73-02.material:
Chitoro chesipo chakagadzirwa nemaoko chinogadzira zvinhu q (integer) pamwedzi uye chinotengesa zvose. Mutengo wose wemwedzi mumwe i C(q) = 50 + 10q + q² (yuniti: 천 원). Pazvo, 50 mutengo wakagadzikwa, unobhadharwa mwedzi wega wega kunyange kana pasina chinhu chimwe chakagadzirwa. Mhindu = mutengo wekutengesa × q − C(q). Mutengo weavhareji pachinhu chimwe i C(q) ÷ q. (q² inoverengwa se 'q squared'.)

Huwandu hwekugadzira q (zvinhu) | Mutengo wose (천 원) | Mutengo weavhareji pachinhu chimwe (천 원)
1 | 61 | 61.00
3 | 89 | 29.67
5 | 125 | 25.00
7 | 169 | 24.14
8 | 194 | 24.25
10 | 250 | 25.00
15 | 425 | 28.33
20 | 650 | 32.50

(Verenga tebhura nenzira q, mutengo wose, mutengo weavhareji. Pakati pemaintegers e q, mutengo weavhareji wakaderera zvikuru uri pa q=7.)
y-m-73-02.prereq.2: Kusiyanisa kukosha kweavhareji (pachinhu chimwe) nekukosha kwose
y-m-73-02.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo rwemitengo ruchaoneswa chidimbu nechidimbu. Panhanho yega yega, sarudza kutonga kunokodzera zvikuru zvino.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.hint.0: Panhanho yega yega, tanga wanyora kuti nhamba dzipi dzaunoziva zvino uye nhamba dzipi dzausati waziva.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.hint.1: Sarudza nhamba mbiri kana matatu uye uvaenzanise zvakananga kuongorora kana kutonga kwawakasarudza kuchienderana nenhamba dzemhindu dzakaratidzwa.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Unongoziva tebhura iri pamusoro. Hausati waziva mutengo wekutengesa pachinhu chimwe.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Tinogona kutaura kuti 'mhindu huru kana tichigadzira zvinhu 7, umo mutengo weavhareji wakaderera zvikuru' here?
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Mhindu inoenderana nemutengo wekutengesa, saka tebhura yemutengo yoga haigoni kukuudza kuti huwandu hwekugadzira hupi hunopa mhindu huru. Zvino, 'kumira pakutonga' ndiyo mhinduro inotsigirwa zvakanyanya.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Hongu. Pazvinhu 7, umo mutengo pachinhu chimwe uri pasi zvikuru, mhindu inowanda zvikuru futi.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakabatanidza mutengo mudiki zvakananga nemhindu huru. Mhindu inoenderanawo nemutengo wekutengesa, saka haigoni kusimbiswa netebhura yemutengo yoga.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Usingazivi mutengo wekutengesa haugoni kuverenga profit, saka zvichiri nguva yakanyanya kutonga parizvo.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Hauna kukanganwa kuti profit ndiwo musiyano pakati pe revenue ne cost. Wakaratidza kuti ruzivo rupi rwekuwedzera rwunofanira kuzikanwa.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Kana ukagadzira zvinhu zvishoma pasi pe7, mutengo wechinhu chimwe unodzikira, saka profit inova hombe.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Mutafura, ma outputs ari pasi (zvinhu 5, zvinhu 3) chaizvoizvo ane mutengo wechinhu chimwe wakakwira. Unofanira kutarisa zvakare kuti tafura inoverengwa nenzira ipi.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Mutengo wekutengesa pachinhu chimwe wazikanwa kuti ndi40 (천 원). Kuverenga profit = 40q − C(q), profit ndi111 kana q=7, 150 kana q=10, 175 kana q=15, 150 kana q=20, uye 75 kana q=25.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ungatonga sei zvino? (Mukati memaoutputs anoratidzwa mutafura)
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Kana mutengo wekutengesa uri pamusoro zvikuru peaverage cost ye24.14, saka kana ukagadzira zvinhu zvakawanda kupfuura 7, revenue inowedzerwa inova hombe kupfuura cost inowedzerwa, saka profit inowedzera zvakare. Profit hombe zvakanyanya iri pazvinhu 15 ne175 (kuverenga ma integers), uye mushure meizvozvo inodzikira.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Profit hombe zvakanyanya kana uchigadzira zvinhu 7, apo average cost iri diki zvikuru.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Makosha makuru kupfuura 111 yezvinhu 7 anoonekwa pazvinhu 10 (150) nepazvinhu 15 (175). Enzanisa nenhamba dzawakangotarisa.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Zvinhu zvawakawanda zvaunogadzira, profit inoramba ichiwedzera.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kutarisa zvinhu 20 (150) nezvinhu 25 (75), kubva papoinzi imwe profit inodzikira. Kutonga uku hakuna kuverenga tafura kusvika kumagumo.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Kugadzira zvinhu zvakawanda kupfuura 7 kunopa profit hombe, uye zvinhu 15 ndiyo hombe zvakanyanya.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wakaenzanisa zvakananga nhamba dzeprofit uye wakaverenga kuti average cost iri pasi zvikuru neprofit hombe zvakanyanya zvinogona kuva zvakasiyana.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Makwikwi akakura uye mutengo wekutengesa pachinhu chimwe wadzikira kusvika ku24 (천 원). Fixed cost ye50 ichiri kubhadharwa mwedzi uno kunyange kana kugadzira kwamiswa. Profit = 24q − C(q): −50 kana q=0, −5 kana q=5, −2 kana q=6, −1 kana q=7, −2 kana q=8, uye −10 kana q=10.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Pamutengo uyu, kutonga kwakakodzera zvakanyanya kuplan yekugadzira yemwedzi uno ndekupi?
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Pamutengo we24, output yega yega inorasikirwa. Asi fixed cost ye50 inobhadharwa zvayo, saka −1 pazvinhu 7 yakanaka zvikuru kupfuura −50 pazvinhu 0. (Dai fixed cost yaigona kudzivirirwa, kutonga kwaizochinja, asi mubasa iri takafungidzira kuti haigoni kudzivirirwa.)
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Kurasikirwa kuripo, asi kurasikirwa kudiki kuri pazvinhu 7, saka zviri nani kuzvigadzira.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakaisa mukuenzanisa mamiriro ekuti fixed cost inobhadharwa kunyange kana usingagadziri chinhu. Izvi zvakasiyana nekutonga kunosiya fixed cost.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Output yega yega inorasikirwa, saka zviri nani kusagadzira chinhu chimwe chete.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Kutonga uku kwakasiya −50 yekusagadzira chinhu. Pasi pemamiriro ekuti fixed cost inobhadharwa zvayo, enzanisawo profit pazvinhu 0.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Kana ukagadzira zvinhu 7, apo average cost iri diki zvikuru, mwedzi uno uchava ne profit.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wakasiya kuti average cost ye24.14 yakakura kupfuura mutengo wekutengesa we24. Kunyange average cost diki zvikuru iri pamusoro pemutengo.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.reflect: Tarisa kutonga kwako katatu. Ndakawo output ine average cost diki zvikuru yaiva yakafanana neoutput ine profit hombe zvakanyanya? Apo mutengo wekutengesa wakachinja, output ine profit hombe zvakanyanya yakachinja sei?
y-m-73-02.s.s2.prompt: Kana mutengo wekutengesa uri 40 (천 원), isa ma outputs q 3 akasiyana ane profit hombe kupfuura kugadzira zvinhu 7, apo average cost iri diki zvikuru. (q ndi integer kubva ku1 kusvika ku30)
y-m-73-02.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza makosha mashoma e q senge 7, 10, 20, 25, uverenge profit, uienzanise ne111, uye uironge mutafura.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.hint.1: Kuti utsvage apo inotanga kupfuura 111 nekudzikira zvakare, chinja q imwe imwe uye uedze miganhu.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Ndi integer kubva ku1 kusvika ku30.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.fail.c1: q inofanira kuva integer kubva ku1 kusvika ku30.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Profit haina kukura kupfuura 111. Verenga 40q − C(q) uye uienzanise ne111 yezvinhu 7.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.explain: Profit ndi −q² + 30q − 50, saka yakakura kupfuura 111 kune q=8 kusvika ku22. Semuenzaniso: q=8 inopa 126, 10 inopa 150, 15 inopa 175, uye 22 inopa 126. q=23 inopa 111, yakaenzana, uye 25 inopa 75, iri pasi pezvinhu 7. Profit hombe zvakanyanya iri pazvinhu 15 (175).
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Uchishandisa nhamba, tsanangura kuti nei, kana mutengo wekutengesa uri 40, zvinhu 7 zvine average cost diki zvikuru zvisiri output ine profit hombe zvakanyanya.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Isa zvinhu 7 nezvinhu 10 padivi pemumwe mutafura yeprofit uye utarise kwakabva musiyano wemaprofit maviri.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Verenga zvakaparadzana cost inowedzerwa ne revenue inowedzerwa kana uchibva pazvinhu 7 uchienda ku8, uye uenzanise.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Kana ukagadzira chinhu chimwe chekuwedzera kupfuura 7 ...
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora mutsananguro yako here kuti 'average cost pachinhu chimwe' ne 'profit' huwandu hwakasiyana?
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakatarisa here nhamba dzawakashandisa mutafura yeprofit?
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Wakafunga here nezvechokwadi chekuti mhedziso inogona kuchinja kana mutengo wekutengesa wachinja?
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Average cost ingori mutengo wechinhu chimwe. Kana mutengo wekutengesa uri 40, mutengo wekuwedzera kubva pachinhu chechi8 kupfuura 7 (anenge 25) uri pasi pe40, saka zvawakawanda zvaunogadzira, profit inokura. Chaizvoizvo, zvinhu 7 zvinopa 111 uye zvinhu 15 zvinopa 175.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Mutengo ndi40, wakasiyana zvikuru neaverage cost ye24.14. Chero bedzi mutengo wekuwedzera wekuwedzera zvinhu uri pasi pemutengo we40, kugadzira zvakawanda kunopa profit hombe. Zvinhu 10 zvinopa 150, yakakura kupfuura 111 yezvinhu 7.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Tsananguro imwe inoisa mutengo wekuwedzera mumashoko

y-m-73-01.s.s2.ok.c1: p ne q ndi nhamba dzakazara mukati mehuwandu.
y-m-73-01.title: Kana yakakwira 50% ndokudzika 50%
y-m-73-01.topic: Kushandisa shanduko dzemaperesenti imwe pashure peimwe
y-m-73-01.goal: Uchishandisa chokwadi chekuti shanduko yega yega yeperesenti inobva pakukosha kwakangotangira, wana kukanganisa mukugadzirisa kwakangowedzera maperesenti, uye ugadzire wega misanganiswa yekuwedzera nekudzikisa inodzokera kukukosha kwekutanga.
y-m-73-01.material: Nhamba yevashanyi pazuva yeshopu yepaIndaneti yakakwira 50% kubva panhamba yekutanga muNdira, wobva wadzika 50% kubva panhamba yeNdira muKukadzi. Shanduko yega yega yeperesenti inobva panhamba yevashanyi 'mwedzi wakangotangira'. Tora nhamba yekutanga yevashanyi se100, uye utore migumisiro semakosha etheory umo madhesimali akabvumidzwa. Pazasi pane kugadzirisa kwemudzidzi mumwe.
y-m-73-01.thinking.1: Kuziva kuti kana base ichichinja, peresenti imwe chete inova huwandu hwakasiyana
y-m-73-01.prereq.0: Kuverenga kuwedzera nekudzikisa kwemaperesenti nekuwanza (ukuru hwechikoro chepakati)
y-m-73-01.prereq.2: Chiratidzo H3 pabasa iri chiratidzo chekuoma chebatch iyi yekugadzira chete; hachireve kuti curriculum inopa zvinhu izvi kugiredhi rakati. Kufungidzira: mudzidzi anosangana kekutanga nemathematics eeconomics pachiyero chechikoro chepamusoro.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara mumwe usina kururama mukugadzirisa uku.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.hint.0: Pamutsara wega wega, nyora kuti unoti pane vashanyi vangani, uye uwane mitsara miviri inopa nhamba dzakasiyana kumwedzi mumwe chete.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.hint.1: Mumutsara 2 nemutsara 3, ongorora kuti +50% ne −50% imwe neimwe i50% yenhamba ipi.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.line.3: Sezvo +50% ne −50% zvichiwedzera kuita 0%, nhamba yevashanyi muKukadzi i100, yakafanana neyekutanga.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.line.4: Saka nhamba yevashanyi haina kuchinja mumwedzi miviri.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 3 tawoona unopa vashanyi 75 kuKukadzi, asi mutsara 4 unoti 100, saka hazvienderani. +50% ne −50% mumutsara 4 zvine mabase akasiyana (wekutanga unobva pa100, wechipiri unobva pa150). Maperesenti anogona kuwedzerwa nekubviswa chete kana ane base imwe chete. Saka mutsara 4 hauna kururama, uye mutsara 5, wakavakirwa pairi, husina kururamawo.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira misanganiswa inodzokera chaizvo kukukosha kwekutanga. Isa mapeya 2 akasiyana (p, q) akadai kuti kukosha kunokwira p% mumwedzi wekutanga ndokudzika q% (zvichibva pakukosha panguva iyoyo) mumwedzi unotevera, kuti mushure memwedzi miviri kwakaenzana chaizvo nekutanga. p inhamba yakazara kubva pa1 kusvika pa500, uye q inhamba yakazara kubva pa1 kusvika pa99.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza p, wana kukosha mushure memwedzi wekutanga, wobva waedza iwe amene kuti unofanira kuderedza peresenti ipi kubva paro kuti udzokere pa100.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.hint.1: Edza kana p ne q zvichigona kuenzana, uye kana kwete, enzanisa kana q yakakura kana diki kupfuura p.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.fail.c1: p inofanira kuva nhamba yakazara kubva pa1 kusvika pa500, uye q inofanira kuva nhamba yakazara kubva pa1 kusvika pa99.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Kukosha mushure memwedzi miviri kwakafanana nekutanga.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Kukosha mushure memwedzi miviri kwakasiyana nekutanga. Tanga wawana kukosha mushure memwedzi wekutanga, wobva waongorora kukosha kwaunowana nekudzikisa q% kubva paro.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.explain: Mienzaniso: Kana ichikwira 25% inova 125, uye sezvo 20% ye125 i25, kudzikisa 20% kunopa 100. Kana ichikwira 100% inova 200, uye kudzikisa 50% kunopa 100; kana ichikwira 150% inova 250, uye kudzikisa 60% kunopa 100. (300, 75) ne (400, 80) zvinoshandawo. Nokuti kukosha mushure mekuwedzera kwakakura, peresenti inodiwa kudzikisa kudzoka inogara iri diki kupfuura peresenti yekuwedzera.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Uchishandisa nhamba imwe, tsanangura kuti nei p ne q zvisingaenzani mumisanganiswa yawakagadzira.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: Sarudza umwe wemisanganiswa yawakagadzira pamusoro, uye tanga wanyora kukosha mushure memwedzi wekutanga.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Wana kuti q% yekukosha uku i chii, uye uienzanise ne q% yekukosha kwekutanga.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Base yekudzikisa peresenti kubva pa125 i...
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakashandisa mutsananguro yako chokwadi chekuti kukosha mushure memwedzi wekutanga kwakasiyana nekutanga here?
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakataura zvakajeka kuti base yekudzikisa peresenti i chii here?
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Wakaverenga iwe amene nhamba dzawakashandisa ukaongorora kuti dzakarurama here?
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.model.0: Kukosha mushure mekuwedzera kunova kukuru kupfuura 100, saka base yekudzikisa peresenti inochinja. Kana ukadzikisa 25% yekukosha 125 kwakabva pakuwedzera kwe25%, unowana 93.75, saka haidzoki; unofanira kudzikisa 20%, inova 25, kuti uwane 100.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.model.1: Mumwedzi wekutanga base i100, uye mumwedzi wechipiri base ikukosha kukuru 150. Kunyange kune 50% imwe chete, huwandu hwakadzikiswa hwakakura pa75, saka peresenti inodiwa kudzoka inogona kuva diki, sezvinoratidzwa nemuenzaniso (150%, 60%).
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.model.2: Kana p=25 ne q=20, kudzikisa 125 ne20% kunobvisa 25, izvo zvinoidzosera pa100. 25% ye125 i31.25, saka kugadzika q pa25 kunoidzikisa zvakanyanya.
